Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry proteomics part of this study focuses on the immunopeptidomics of HLA-monoallelic B721.221 cells. The primary perturbation for the MS samples is the induction of SARS-CoV-2 protein expression using doxycycline. While the study involves a large cohort of COVID-19 convalescents, those samples were used for T-cell multimer assays and functional analysis, not for the primary MS-based ligandome discovery described in the PRIDE dataset (PXD028862).

The most critical search parameter is the 'no enzyme' (non-specific) cleavage setting, as HLA-presented peptides are not generated by a single protease.
